narration: You ran your numbers through a retirement calculator and got a green checkmark. But that calculator is missing four things — and together they add up to $847,000.
visual: Dark background. A laptop monitor displays a calculator UI with 'ON TRACK ✓' in green and a 75% progress bar. After a beat, a large red X slams across the screen. Below, '$847,000 GAP / 4 THINGS IT FORGOT' springs in with red accent text.

narration: Number one: healthcare. The average couple pays $315,000 out-of-pocket in retirement. And your calculator doesn't have a single line for medical costs.
visual: Light background. A bold red medical cross SVG springs onto screen. A stethoscope appears left, a pill bottle right. Below the cross, a dollar counter animates from $0 up to $315,000. Footer text: 'YOUR CALCULATOR HAS $0 FOR THIS'.

narration: Number two: tax drag. Every dollar in your traditional 401k is pre-tax money — meaning the IRS silently owns 22 cents of every dollar you've ever saved.
visual: Dark background. A pie chart fades in: 78% green slice labeled 'YOU', then a 22% red IRS slice snaps in. Below, '22¢ BELONGS TO THE IRS' springs in with red text. Footer: 'NOT IN THE CALCULATOR'.

narration: Number three: sequence risk. Retire right before a market crash and you lock in losses forever. Identical savings — one person runs out fifteen years early.
visual: Light background. A line chart with two animated paths: a green 'GOOD START' line trending upward, and a red 'BAD START' line crashing then bottoming out at zero. Labels appear: 'SAME SAVINGS. RETIRE 1 YEAR APART. ONE RUNS OUT 15 YEARS EARLY'.

narration: Number four: real inflation. Healthcare costs inflated six to eight percent for decades. Your 'safe' withdrawal gets cut in half in just eleven years.
visual: Light background. Three growing red bars appear sequentially: tall bar 'Today $1,000', medium bar 'Year 11 $512', short bar 'Year 22 $263'. A baseline and x-axis label show the shrinking buying power over time.

narration: Your calculator shows what you want to see. The real number is $847,000 bigger. Follow for the financial truths they don't put on the green checkmark.
visual: Light background. Two calculator SVGs spring in side by side. Left calculator shows 'ON TRACK ✓' with a red X crossed over it. Right shows '$847K SHORT' in red. CTA: 'FOLLOW FOR MORE / FINANCIAL TRUTHS THEY DON'T TEACH' pulses in.
